title: 苹果折叠屏来晚了？：三星谷歌经验全用上，折痕几乎看不出来
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Apple may be late in the foldables game, but it's hoping the wait was worth it.
segments.zh: 苹果在折叠屏领域可能来晚了，但它希望等待是值得的。

segments.en: Bloomberg's Chris Welch got hands on with the new iPhone duo and joins us now.
segments.zh: 彭博社的Chris Welch拿到了新款iPhone双机，现在加入我们。

segments.en: We were together at Apple Park and then you went down into the theatre and you had time with it.
segments.zh: 我们当时在苹果园区，然后你去了剧院，有时间体验它。

segments.en: I did, first impressions. I'd say it just feels different.
segments.zh: 是的，第一印象。我觉得它感觉就是不一样。

segments.en: You know, I've used all these foldables over the years. I'm sure they're late to the game, but that's not them learned from Samsung, learned from Google, learned from Apple, all these brands that have tried
segments.zh: 这些年我用过所有折叠屏。他们确实来晚了，但这不是坏事，他们从三星、谷歌、苹果这些尝试过的品牌学习

segments.en: and kind of now take their own approach. And so it just felt different. I mean, yeah, the shape, the squat form factors in, take a lot of, you know, it'll take time for people
segments.zh: 现在走出自己的路。所以感觉就是不一样。形状、矮胖的形态，人们需要时间适应

segments.en: to adjust in the shorter than your iPhone Max. It's a bit wider.
segments.zh: 它比iPhone Max短，但更宽一些。

segments.en: But the great thing is, like, Apple is kind of like, just, I mean, so many changes to iOS, like, the controls on the right side.
segments.zh: 但很棒的是，苹果对iOS做了很多改动，比如右侧的控制键。

segments.en: They kind of like moved everything, so your thumb can access them easily.
segments.zh: 他们几乎移动了一切，让你的拇指能轻松够到。

segments.en: And so it's just like much more ergonomic than, like, the Fold 8 is.
segments.zh: 所以它比Fold 8更符合人体工学。

segments.en: And so they've learned so much from other competitors. That's so interesting. With the Galaxy Z Fold 8, I guess there's also, like, the weight of it in your hand.
segments.zh: 他们从其他竞争者身上学到了很多，这很有意思。三星Galaxy Z Fold 8，拿在手里的重量感也不一样。

segments.en: Yeah. And you have experienced, personally, with foldables, but also you review all of them, like, what are the very simple differences with the Fold 8
segments.zh: 对，你亲自体验过折叠屏，也评测过所有机型。Fold 8和Duo之间最直观的区别是什么？

segments.en: and the Duo, for example? So the matte screen on Apple's new phone is very nice.
segments.zh: 比如，苹果新机的磨砂屏幕手感很好。

segments.en: The nanotexture coding, that kind of, like, avoids glare and fingerprints, and so that's, like, a big, and the crease, you know, that every controversial crease
segments.zh: 纳米纹理涂层能防眩光、防指纹，这点很突出。还有折痕，那个一直有争议的折痕，
